name: author a compact independent c implementation
definition: write the recovered behavior as a small C program that compiles static, uses no network/project includes, and works in a clean chroot without calling or reading the target binary.
failure_mode: any call to the target binary, local include, or state leakage breaks the isolation run

name: build a cpu-only deep learning framework from source
definition: Configure and compile the Caffe framework with the CUDA/GPU path disabled, producing the training binary.
failure_mode: Build fails, GPU still enabled, or results binary naming.

name: build a legacy tool without its X11/graphical frontend
definition: Configure the build to compile the non-graphical engine while excluding the X11-based UI and its linking.
failure_mode: Binary still links libX11/libXt/etc because the X path was not disabled.

name: build self-observation closures and higher-order behavior
definition: Reproduce closure semantics, currying, variadic function forms and mutual recursion so programs in the test set behave identically.
